title: Lavazza Espresso Whole Bean Coffee, Medium Roast, 100% Arabica, 2.2 lb Bag (Pack of 1)

reviews.title: reliable beans for espresso & more
reviews.body: I’ve tried many different beans incl all sorts of crafted roasts with my Breville machine. At the end I always get back to these beans. Output is always a solid espresso, also when a bit out of the perfect brewing time window due to adjustments etc.
reviews.author: roltrader

reviews.title: Pleasant but tricky
reviews.body: Pro: quite aromatic when grinding the beans. Flavour is just right for my wife but not meCon: if ground too fine it tastes a bit sour. We tested the medium fine which is just right for us.
reviews.author: hlchong

reviews.title: Delicious coffee
reviews.body: Delicious coffee with a mokapot or hario v60 brewing methoda
reviews.author: Bernard L. T. Ong

reviews.title: Nice flavor
reviews.body: I have narrowed down my palate over the years. This is one of the few flavors I keep buying. Sumatra Mandheling, Columbian, Lavazza Oro, Lavazza Espresso are my favorites.
reviews.author: Seng

reviews.title: Very fresh
reviews.body: 2nd time ordering. Both times were also very fresh when delivered. It taste nice.
reviews.author: Darby
